description: The **Wcareer** platform is a **full‑stack career development ecosystem** that combines a **React/Vite** client, a **Next.js** mock‑interview module, an **Express** backend, and a suite of **Python AI/ML services** powered by **LangChain**, **Google Generative AI**, and vector search with **FAISS**. It follows a **micro‑services‑oriented, RESTful** architecture with **event‑driven** updates for community features, exposing AI models as **AI‑as‑a‑Service** endpoints. Core data stores include **MongoDB** for user data, **Neo4j** for skill‑graph relationships, and **FAISS** for semantic search, all orchestrated via Docker‑based services.
longDescription:
**Core System Architecture**
The system is divided into distinct layers: a **client** (`client/`) built with **React 19**, **Tailwind CSS**, and **Radix UI** for a responsive UI; a **mockInterview** module using **Next.js** for interview simulations; a **server** (`server/`) running **Express 4.21** with **JWT** authentication, **bcrypt**, and **Nodemailer** for email workflows; and a **WCareers** Python service (`llm-server/`) that hosts LLM‑driven models (`cognitive_test_model.py`, `resume_analysis.py`, etc.) behind a **FastAPI/Streamlit** API. Communication between the JavaScript and Python layers occurs via **RESTful HTTP** calls using **Axios** on the frontend and **requests** in the backend.

**Data Ingestion & Processing Pipelines**
User‑generated content (resumes, skill updates, interview answers) is first validated by middleware (`authMidd`, CORS, cookie parser) before being persisted to **MongoDB**. Skill relationships are enriched and stored in **Neo4j**, enabling graph queries for the skill‑graph endpoints (`/api/skill/graph`). For semantic operations, documents are vectorized with **Sentence Transformers** and indexed in **FAISS**, supporting endpoints like `/api/skill/trending`. The AI layer consumes these vectors and external data sources (via **BeautifulSoup4**, **PyPDF**) to generate personalized recommendations.

**Execution Flow**
A typical user journey starts at `http://localhost:5173` where the React app authenticates via `/api/auth/login`. Authenticated requests fetch data from `/api/job`, `/api/roadmap`, or trigger AI services such as `/api/resume/analyze`. Mock interview creation (`POST /api/interview/create`) stores a session in MongoDB, then the frontend polls `/api/interview/:mockId` for questions and submits answers to `/api/interview/answer`. Feedback is generated by the Python LLM service and returned via `/api/interview/:mockId/feedback`.

**Security Guardrails**
All protected routes enforce **JWT** verification and role‑based checks. Sensitive operations (password reset, email verification) use **one‑time‑passwords** sent via **Nodemailer**. Environment secrets are managed with **dotenv**, and Docker containers isolate the AI models from the Node.js runtime. Rate limiting and input sanitization are applied at the Express middleware level to mitigate abuse.
myContributions: Implemented JWT‑based authentication and role‑based access control in `authController.js`.
Developed RESTful CRUD endpoints for resume upload, analysis, and enhancement (`/api/resume`).
Created skill‑graph services using Neo4j and exposed `/api/skill/graph` for frontend consumption.
Integrated Google Generative AI via `llm_service.py` to generate personalized career roadmaps.
Built mock interview flow with Next.js, including question generation and feedback endpoints.
Implemented vector indexing with FAISS for semantic skill search and recommendation.
Set up Dockerfile and CI pipeline for the Python AI server, ensuring reproducible environments.
Configured email verification and password reset workflows using Nodemailer.
Added real‑time notification hooks for community discussions (event‑driven architecture).
Wrote comprehensive documentation and API tables in `COMPREHENSIVE_PROJECT_DOCUMENTATION.md`.

features: User registration, login, and secure JWT authentication.
Resume upload, parsing, AI‑driven analysis, and enhancement suggestions.
Skill tracking with trending insights and graph‑based relationship visualization.
AI‑generated career roadmaps and personalized job recommendations.
Mock interview creation, real‑time question delivery, and AI feedback.
Community forum with discussions, posting, and notification system.
Dashboard with analytics, charts, and progress tracking.
PDF generation of resumes and roadmaps via jsPDF.
Video interview recording using React Webcam.
Multi‑modal AI integration (text, voice, PDF) powered by LangChain and Gemini AI.
challenges: Balancing polyglot persistence (MongoDB, Neo4j, FAISS) while maintaining data consistency.
Optimizing LLM inference latency within Docker containers for real‑time feedback.
Ensuring secure handling of sensitive user data across multiple services and environments.
Coordinating version compatibility between React 19, Vite 6, and Next.js modules.
Designing a scalable event‑driven notification system without a dedicated message broker.
learnings: Effective use of JWT and refresh tokens to secure micro‑service communication.
Integrating vector databases (FAISS) with traditional document stores for hybrid search.
Managing environment variables across Node.js and Python services using dotenv.
Leveraging LangChain to orchestrate multiple LLM providers within a single API.
Implementing graph queries in Neo4j to model complex skill relationships.
architectureOverview: Frontend built with React, TailwindCSS, Next.js. Backend API powered by Express. AI/ML capabilities powered by LangChain, Gemini AI. Persistence managed by MongoDB.

Add role‑based dashboards for mentors and recruiters with granular permissions.
Expand AI capabilities to include real‑time speech‑to‑text analysis during mock interviews.
Implement server‑side rendering for SEO‑critical pages using Next.js.

remotionVideoScript.voiceoverScript: Welcome to the comprehensive 5-minute technical engineering deep dive into Wcareer. Section 1 System Topology: Engineered with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, combining a decoupled backend powered by Express and client interface built with React, TailwindCSS, Next.js. Section 2 Static Code Analysis: AST code scanners inspect package manifests and component dependencies. Section 3 API Network Layer: Exposing 19 REST and WebSocket routes with parameter validation schemas. Section 4 Source Code Hierarchy: Codebase organized into isolated modules across Client, Src, App, Components. Section 5 Intelligence & Persistence: AI inference accelerated by LangChain, Gemini AI with persistence managed by MongoDB. Section 6 Performance Metrics: Optimized with 1080p rendering and -16 LUFS loudness normalization. Section 7 Deployment & Outro: Explore the complete repository on GitHub at Sameer-Bagul slash Wcareer.
